Policy:

Graduate and Credential students must have completed at least one semester of coursework, while in residence at Cal State Fullerton in order to qualify for a leave. Leave requests should be submitted before the first day of classes for the semester being requested. However, a retroactive leave of absence may be considered only for serious medical issues or other extenuating circumstances that prevented timely registration or submitting a leave of absence request prior to the start of the term.

A leave of absence is normally not granted for longer than two consecutive semesters. Leave requests for two consecutive semesters and any medical leave requests require appropriate substantial documentation detailing the circumstances that make it impossible or inadvisable to register for classes (e.g. doctor's note, employer's verification, etc.). An approved leave does not extend the time limit imposed by the State for completing degree or credential requirements. It also does not exempt students from new credential requirements imposed by the State regardless of catalog year.

Grounds for requesting a retroactive leave of absence include:

  1. Illness or disability (permanent or temporary) or similar personal exigencies including pregnancy that makes it impossible or inadvisable for a student to register for classes
  2. Activities that enhance a student's professional career objectives
  3. Active duty in the armed forces of the United States
  4. Severe financial hardship
  5. Other reasons at the discretion of the appropriate graduate administrator or their designee

A retroactive leave of absence will not be granted in order for a student to take coursework at a community college or other university for financial or academic reasons.

Undergraduate and Second Bachelor's Degree Students Leave of Absence Policy

An approved leave of absence authorizes the student to return without reapplying to the university and continue under the catalog requirements that applied prior to the absence. A Retroactive Leave of Absence may be requested for one semester based on certain documented extenuating circumstances, or two semesters for the reasons stipulated below (documentation is required). Documentation must also include evidence to support the reason the student was not able to submit the request for a leave of absence before the start of the term. Students must have completed at least one semester in residence at Cal State Fullerton and must be in good academic standing.

*Reference university catalog*

One semester (not including stop-out semester)

  • Documentation – Required for all requests (no exceptions). Medical reason requires a doctor’s note.
  • Deadline for submitting form – This form must be submitted no later than Census Date as defined in the Registration Guide for the semester requesting the leave. If a leave of absence request is being submitted after the term Census Date, the student should submit a retroactive leave of absence request. A request for a leave of absence submitted after term has ended will not be considered.

Two semesters (not including stop-out semester)
Requests for a Leave of Absence of two semesters in length are confined to circumstances of:

  1. Illness or disability - self or immediate family member (permanent or temporary, including pregnancy). Medical reason requires a doctor's note.
  2. Active duty in the armed forces of the United States
  3. Study Abroad programs
  4. Educational/professional training programs not available at Cal State Fullerton
  • Documentation – Required for all requests (no exceptions). A request for a retroactive leave of absence should included documentation supporting the reason the request wasn’t submitted prior to the start of the term.

    • Maximum Leave of Absence request: Two semesters - (not including stop-out semester)
    Use of Policy: This policy is not designed for repeated use.
    Extensions: A Leave of Absence cannot be extended. If approved, it is for the specified semester(s) only.
    Decision: You will receive an email notification of the decision.

Policy:

Students must be in good academic standing AND have completed at least six units (master’s & DNP students) or eight units (Ed.D. students) toward the degree, or if a credential student, students must have completed at least one semester of coursework in good academic standing, while in residence at Cal State Fullerton in order to qualify for a leave. Leave requests should be submitted before the first day of classes for the semester being requested.

Leave requests for two consecutive semesters and any medical leave requests require appropriate substantial documentation detailing the circumstances that make it impossible or inadvisable to register for classes (e.g. doctor’s note, employer’s verification, etc.). A leave of absence is normally not granted for longer than two consecutive semesters. An approved leave does not extend the time limit imposed by the State for completing degree or credential requirements. It also does not exempt students from new credential requirements imposed by the State regardless of catalog year.

Grounds for requesting a leave of absence include:

  1. Illness or disability (permanent or temporary) or similar personal exigencies including pregnancy that makes it impossible or inadvisable for a student to register for classes
  2. Activities that enhance a student’s professional career objectives
  3. Active duty in the armed forces of the United States
  4. Severe financial hardship
  5. Other reasons at the discretion of the Associate Vice President for Academic Programs or their designee

A leave of absence is not granted in order for a student to take coursework at a community college or other university for financial or academic reasons.

A retroactive leave of absence may be considered only for serious medical issues or other extenuating circumstances that prevented timely registration or submitting a leave of absence request prior to the start of the term. The retroactive leave of absence will be reviewed by all appropriate departments and can either be granted or denied. When submitting a retroactive leave of absence request:

Complete and sign the 'Request for Retroactive Leave of Absence' form

Attach documentation as explained below.

It is important to provide appropriate and thorough documentation for your retroactive leave of absence request. If your Retroactive Leave of Absence request is submitted without any documentation, your form will be returned to you without processing. The form can only be resubmitted when appropriate documentation is attached.

An attached statement from the student describing the reason for requesting a retroactive leave of absence is not considered documentation.

Documentation must be from a source other than the student to verify the reason for the request and the reason a request for a leave of absence wasn’t submitted prior to the start of the term ,(example: letter from a health care provider, military orders, study abroad contract, etc).
